messages:
amanda - design: dropping a proposal for a 'Scoped key creator' modal + a permissions matrix on the keys list. goal: make it impossible to accidentally grant too much access. figma: https://figma.com/file/scoped123

maria - ux: love the matrix idea. helps surface who can do what. UX asks: make scopes readable (not just keywords). e.g., show 'Read logs (read_logs)' not just read_logs.

raj - eng: backend note: scopes are arbitrary strings for some integrations. we'll map common ones to friendly labels but need a fallback to show raw scope text. UI should handle long scope names with truncation + tooltip.

kelly - product: copy ask: add a short explanation under the matrix: 'Scopes define what this key can do. Limit to the minimum required.' and a one-click 'Least privilege helper' that picks recommended scopes based on intended use (server, client, analytics).

amanda - design: will add that helper. also proposing inline examples for each preset (e.g., Server: read, write; Client: read only). should we show a small risk indicator per scope (Low/Medium/High)?

maria - ux: yes but use icons + text (shield/triangle) not only color. accessibility for colorblind users. Also keyboard-only: presets must be operable with arrow keys and Enter.

raj - eng: permissions enforcement: when someone without key.admin tries to create a key with high-risk scopes, the API returns 403 and a list of disallowed scopes. UI should pre-validate against that same rule to avoid round trips. we'll add an endpoint /v1/permissions/check that takes scopes and returns allowed/disallowed. include that in docs.

amanda - design: nice. UI will show a red inline pill for disallowed scopes with a 'Request access' link that opens a prefilled request modal. Request modal will include org, scopes requested, and suggested approver.

kelly - product: for the request flow text use: 'Request elevated permission to create this key. Your org admins will review and be notified.' keep it short.

maria - ux: empty state for keys list thought: instead of just 'No keys' have a 3-step starter (Create scoped key, Set rotation policy, Add to service). show a sample policy template users can copy (one-liner) and a 'Try sample' button that pre-fills the creator.

raj - eng: add an API snippet for the sample template in the modal docs. e.g.,

```
POST /v1/keys
{
  "name": "service-A-readonly",
  "scopes": ["read_logs", "embeddings:read"],
  "rotation_policy": "90d",
  "metadata": {"env": "staging"}
}
```

amanda - design: nice. microcopy nit: the secret preview should say 'Shown once. Copy now.' and the copy button should confirm with a non-modal toast and an aria-live announcement.

maria - ux: be careful with the toast timing: if the modal closes immediately the live region must exist before closing; else VoiceOver misses it. prefer a persistent inline confirmation in the keys table for 5s.

raj - eng: our SDKs will support a createKey endpoint that returns {secret, expires_at}. we'll advise front end to mask after 30s and require re-auth to reveal again. include that in guidance.

kelly - product: rotation policy quick presets: Off / 30d / 90d / Rotate on compromise. In the UI, show the expected operational impact per preset (e.g., 30d = low overhead, high security). Keep language user-friendly.

amanda - design: adding a compact help panel on the right that explains each preset in 1-2 lines. also asking: should we surface last-rotate timestamp in the list? helps decide immediately.

maria - ux: yes show 'Last rotated' column, sortable. make sure the table's responsive — collapse less-important columns on mobile.

raj - eng: accessibility: table must use role=table with proper headers. keyboard: support Shift+Space for selecting multiple rows. tri-state header checkbox as discussed earlier in other threads.

kelly - product: one more product copy request: change the primary CTA text to 'Create scoped key' not just 'Create' so users know scope matters. Also adjust success copy: 'Scoped API key created. Remember to store the secret now.'

amanda - design: will mock v2 with the helper, presets, request flow, and inline API snippet. final design QA ask: run color contrast and keyboard walkthrough. I'll tag accessibility when I push the file. :mag: 

infra-bot: note: perms-check endpoint available at /v1/permissions/check. rate limit 60rpm. Audit events: key.create.request and key.create.granted.
